item.tib: sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i o rgyan byang phyogs ki la ya yi dur khrod mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ge btab pa yang / mkha' 'gro gnyan la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba yis/ bdag sogs phyi rabs rjes 'brang rnams/ kha ba can gyi bod yul du/ bstan pa dar rgyas bkra shis shog/
